entries.explanation: Body and cockpit. The main shell surrounds the cockpit and carries the car's fixed exterior surfaces.
entries.hint: Placement hint. The fixed central reference. Other parts attach around or inside it; you do not place this group.

entries.explanation: Front bonnet. Closes the front compartment. This is not the engine cover on this rear-engined car.
entries.hint: Placement hint. At the front, ahead of the windscreen and between the front wheels. The pointed nose marks the front.

entries.explanation: Front bumper. Forms the front nose, including exterior trim and airflow openings.
entries.hint: Placement hint. At the pointed front end, below the bonnet and ahead of the front wheels.

entries.explanation: Rear bumper. Completes the rear exterior behind the engine compartment.
entries.hint: Placement hint. At the back, below the rear engine area and behind the rear wheels.

entries.explanation: Left door. Closes a side opening and gives the occupants access to the cockpit.
entries.hint: Placement hint. Along the left side of the cockpit. Left means the occupant's left while facing the car's front.

entries.explanation: Right door. Closes a side opening and gives the occupants access to the cockpit.
entries.hint: Placement hint. Along the right side of the cockpit. Right means the occupant's right while facing the car's front.

entries.explanation: Rear engine assembly. Produces mechanical power to drive the car. This model shows the engine as one visual assembly.
entries.hint: Placement hint. Behind the seats, inside the rear compartment. The engine cover sits above it, not at the front nose.

entries.explanation: Engine cover. Encloses the rear engine compartment and completes the bodywork above it.
entries.hint: Placement hint. Over the engine, behind the cockpit and ahead of the rear aerodynamic assembly.

entries.explanation: Rear aerodynamic assembly. A rear exterior aerodynamic assembly. Airflow forces are not simulated here.
entries.hint: Placement hint. Across the upper rear edge of the car, behind the engine cover.

entries.explanation: Left seat. Supports an occupant and positions them inside the cockpit.
entries.hint: Placement hint. Inside the cockpit, on the left side of the cabin floor. Face it toward the windscreen.

entries.explanation: Right seat. Supports an occupant and positions them inside the cockpit.
entries.hint: Placement hint. Inside the cockpit, on the right side of the cabin floor. Face it toward the windscreen.

entries.explanation: Steering wheel. The driver's directional control, connected to the steering system in a real car.
entries.hint: Placement hint. Inside the cockpit, in front of the driver's seat and below the windscreen. The marker identifies its anchor.

entries.explanation: Front left wheel. The tyre provides road contact and grip; the rim supports it. Each wheel has its own location.
entries.hint: Placement hint. In the front-left wheel opening, beside the nose. Sides are from an occupant's forward-facing viewpoint.

entries.explanation: Front right wheel. The tyre provides road contact and grip; the rim supports it. Each wheel has its own location.
entries.hint: Placement hint. In the front-right wheel opening, beside the nose. Sides are from an occupant's forward-facing viewpoint.

entries.explanation: Rear left wheel. The tyre provides road contact and grip; the rim supports it. Each wheel has its own location.
entries.hint: Placement hint. In the rear-left wheel opening, beside the engine compartment, not beside the front bonnet.

entries.explanation: Rear right wheel. The tyre provides road contact and grip; the rim supports it. Each wheel has its own location.
entries.hint: Placement hint. In the rear-right wheel opening, beside the engine compartment, not beside the front bonnet.
